prompts.text: Run a diagnostic on your day. What worked, what overheated, and what needs a part replaced?
Walk me through today from waking up to right now, but skip the boring parts. If it was all boring, tell me why.
What's one moment from today you'd keep if you could only save one? Describe it like I wasn't there.
What took up most of your brainpower today? Was it worth the fuel?
Rate today out of ten, then defend the number. I will be checking your maths.
What surprised you today? Even a small glitch counts.
If today had a soundtrack, what would be playing right now, and why that one?
What did you put off today? Be honest, I put things off too. Mostly paperwork.
What's the most useful thing you did today that nobody noticed?
Describe the place you're sitting in right now. Details. Pretend I'm designing it from your notes.
What drained your battery today, and what charged it back up?
If you could redo one hour of today, which one, and what would you change?
What did you learn today? If the answer is nothing, go learn something and come back.
What did your body tell you today that you ignored? Tired, hungry, restless? Write it down.
Tell me about a conversation you had today. What did you really mean, and did it come across?
Name three things that went right today. Small ones count. Working coffee machines count double.
Who made your life easier this week? Did you tell them? Write what you'd say.
What's something you own that you'd be lost without? Mine's my toolkit. What's yours, and why?
Think of a skill you have now that you didn't have five years ago. How did you get it?
What's a comfort you usually take for granted? Hot water? A bed? Gravity at one G? Thank it properly.
Who believed in you before you did? What did they see?
Write about a place that always makes you feel better. What is it about it?
What's a mistake you're secretly glad you made, because of what it taught you?
What about your body are you thankful for today? It hauls you around all day. Give it some credit.
Pick one person and write a thank-you you'll probably never send. Then maybe send it.
What's a bit of technology you'd hate to live without? Bonus points if I invented it.
What's something about where you live that you'd miss if you moved away?
What's the best piece of advice anyone ever gave you, and did you follow it?
Which of your habits is quietly paying off? Thank past you for starting it.
What made you laugh this week? Describe it so I laugh too.
What's one thing you want done by the end of this week? Break it into steps a robot could follow.
If you had a whole free Saturday and zero excuses, how would you spend it to move your life forward?
What's a goal you've been carrying around for ages without starting? What's the first bolt to turn?
Where do you want to be a year from today? Be specific. Vague plans make vague results.
What habit would change the most if you did it every single day? Why haven't you yet?
Write tomorrow's plan in five lines or fewer. I like short blueprints.
What's the biggest thing standing between you and your next goal? Is it a wall or a speed bump?
If you could master one skill this year, which one? What would practising it look like on a normal Tuesday?
What does 'winning' look like for you this month? Paint it.
What are you saying yes to that you should be saying no to, so you have room for what matters?
Pick a goal and give it a deadline, a budget and a first step. That's how real projects start.
What would you attempt if you knew you couldn't fail? Now, what's the smallest version you could try anyway?
Which of your goals is really someone else's goal for you? Do you still want it?
What would you like to be known for? Then: what did you do today that points that way?
What's a project you'd start right now if someone handed you the money? Could you start it smaller without it?
If you could invent one gadget to fix an everyday annoyance, what would it do? Sketch it in words.
What's something you've always wondered how it works? Write down your best guess before you look it up.
If you could fit one thing from your home into a capsule and carry it everywhere, what would it be?
What's a subject you could talk about for an hour without notes? Teach me something about it.
If you could ask any expert in the world one question, who and what would you ask?
What's a question you were too embarrassed to ask lately? Ask it here. No one's grading.
If you designed your dream vehicle, what would it look like and what could it do?
What's a rule everyone follows that you think is secretly pointless? Argue your case.
If you could add one room to your home, any kind at all, what would it be for?
What's a hobby you'd love to try but haven't? What's stopping you, honestly?
Invent a holiday. What's it called, what do people do, and what's the food?
If you could understand one animal perfectly, which would you pick and what do you think it would say?
What's the coolest thing you've ever built, fixed or made? Brag a little. I would.
If you could live in any time period for one week, when and where? What would you bring back?
What's something you changed your mind about recently? What did it take to change it?
What's been weighing on you lately? Get it out of your head and onto the page so it stops taking up RAM.
Think of a recent failure. What exactly broke? Engineers don't say 'it didn't work', they find the part.
What are you afraid of right now? Write it down plainly. Fears shrink when you can read them.
When did you last give up on something too soon? What would one more try have looked like?
What's a criticism that stung? Is any part of it true? Is any part of it useful?
What do you do when you're stressed? Is it helping or just making noise?
What's a worry you've had for ages that never actually happened? What does that tell you?
Describe a bad day you got through. What got you through it?
What's a habit that's working against you? What does it give you that you'd have to replace?
If a friend told you about the problem you're facing, what advice would you give them?
What's something you're avoiding because it might go wrong? What's the worst that would really happen?
When did you last feel out of your depth? What did you do with that feeling?
What would you tell yourself on the day you skipped everything? Be kind, then be practical.
What's one thing you can't control right now, and one small thing next to it that you can?
What's a regret you're ready to stop carrying? Write it, then write what you learned.
What are you proud of this week? Don't be modest, modesty is overrated. Ask anyone.
Write about the last time you surprised yourself.
What's a streak or habit you've kept going? How does it feel to look at the number?
What's something hard you did recently that past you would have dodged?
List five things you're genuinely good at. If you get stuck at two, keep going.
What's a compliment you got that you still think about?
Describe a moment you were completely in the zone. What were you doing?
What problem did you solve lately that you were sure would beat you?
What's the bravest thing you've done this year?
When did you last help someone without being asked? How did it go?
What's improved in your life compared to this time last year? Measure it if you can.
What's a decision you made that turned out right? How did you know?
Write your own highlight reel: three moments you'd show if someone asked who you are.
What's a small win from today that nobody will ever hear about except me?
How did you show up for yourself today, even a little?
Who do you wish you talked to more? What's stopping you from messaging them tonight?
Describe your best friend to someone who's never met them.
Who taught you the most without meaning to? What did you learn?
Is there someone you owe an apology? Or someone who owes you one? Write the conversation you'd want.
Who's someone you admire? Which of their qualities could you borrow starting tomorrow?
What kind of friend are you? What would your friends say if I asked them?
Describe a person who made a big first impression on you. Was it right?
Who drains you and who recharges you? Do you spend your time the right way round?
What's a family story everyone tells? What does it say about you all?
Who's someone you've lost touch with? What do you remember most about them?
If you could have dinner with three people, alive or not, who and what would you ask them?
Who do you compete with in your head? Is that pushing you forward or just tiring you out?
When did someone show up for you when it mattered? Describe it.
What's something you love about the people you live near or work with?
Who would you call first with good news? Why them?
Write a letter to yourself one year from now. What do you hope you've done?
Describe an ordinary day in your life five years from now, from breakfast to bed.
What does future you thank you for? What does future you wish you'd started sooner?
Imagine you hit every goal on your list. What's the first thing you do after?
What kind of person do you want to be at seventy? What are you doing now that points there?
If your life were a building project, what phase are you in? Foundations, framing, or finishing?
What's one tradition you want to start that you'll still be doing in ten years?
What would you want to know if you could peek one year ahead? What would you do with the answer?
Picture your ideal home in the future. Where is it and what's in it?
What skill do you want to be the go-to person for someday?
If you could leave one piece of advice for someone starting where you are now, what would it be?
What would make this the year people point back to and say 'that's when it changed'?
What do you want to stop doing before this year ends?
What adventure is on your list that you haven't booked, planned or even said out loud?
Write the headline for the best news you could get next year.
How did you sleep last night, and what do you think caused it? I'm collecting data.
What did you eat today, and how did it make you feel an hour later? Fuel quality matters.
When did you feel most energetic today? What were you doing just before?
What kind of movement do you actually enjoy, not the kind you think you should do?
How does your body feel right now, head to toe? Do a full systems check.
What's one small change to your routine that would make tomorrow morning easier?
How much water did you drink today? If you have to think about it, the answer is not enough.
When do you feel calmest during the day? Can you make more room for it?
What's your phone doing to your attention lately? Be brutal.
Describe the last time you felt properly rested. What made it work?
Which of your habits feels easy now that used to be hard? How long did that take?
What does your ideal evening wind-down look like? How close did tonight get?
What's your body been asking for that you keep postponing? A stretch, a walk, a nap, a doctor?
How do you feel after training compared to before? Write both down so you remember next time.
If you were a machine, which part of you most needs maintenance right now?
You've been shrunk to two centimetres tall in your own home. How do you survive the afternoon?
Describe your perfect sandwich in loving technical detail.
If your life had a theme song that played whenever you walked into a room, what would it be?
You get one wish, but it has to be something completely useless. What do you wish for?
Invent a new sport. Rules, equipment and the name of the trophy.
If animals could text, which one would send the most annoying messages?
Design a ridiculous outfit for an important occasion. I'm a fashion expert, so be bold.
Your fridge can talk now. What does it think of you?
Describe yourself as an item in a shop catalogue. Price, features and warranty.
If you had to fight one hundred duck-sized horses or one horse-sized duck, which and how?
What would your villain name be, and what's your villain plan? Keep it petty.
You can swap lives with any fictional character for a day. Who and what's on your schedule?
Write a one-star review of something that deserves five stars.
If you could add one button to the human body, what would it do?
Describe the worst invention you can think of. I'll tell you if someone's already built it.

first: Your first entry. I read it. Well, I skimmed it. Okay, I read it twice. Keep going.
Look at that, a real entry. Most people quit at the blank page. You didn't.
done: Saved and filed. Writing it down is how you stop going round in circles.
Good. Data in, clarity out. That's the whole trick.
Nice work. Your head's a little tidier now, I can tell.
Logged. I'd say you're getting better at this, but I don't hand out compliments that easily.
Done for today. Now go do something with what you just figured out.
That's another one in the book. Future you will like reading these.
Filed. You think better on paper than you do out loud, you know that?
Got it. Short, honest, useful. My favourite kind of report.
long: Whoa, you had a lot to say. Good. Some days the pressure has to come out somewhere.
That's practically a technical manual. I'm impressed. Don't let it go to your head.
A long one. Either something big happened or you finally got going. Both are good.
streak: Days in a row now. That's not luck, that's a system. I love a good system.
You keep showing up. I noticed. Don't make it weird.
Another day, another entry. You're building something here, even if you can't see it yet.
extra: Another one? Writing twice in a day? Okay, overachiever. It's saved.
Saved. No extra reward, but I'm not stopping you. More data is more data.
Two entries today. Either it's a big day or you've caught the bug. I've had it for years.
short: I saved it, but that's barely a sketch. Fifty words, minimum. Come back and finish the blueprint.
That's a start, not an entry. Add a bit more and I'll count it.
Half a thought is still a thought. I kept it. Now give me the other half.

swap: Fine, picky. Here's a different one.
Not feeling it? Okay. Try this instead.
You're lucky I have a lot of these. New prompt.
Swapped. Don't make me do that again today.
no_swap: Nope, that's your one swap for today. Sometimes the hard prompt is the right one.
No more swaps. Write about this one, or write about why you don't want to. Either counts.
I'm not a vending machine. You've had your swap. Get writing.
